attempts.summary: Task already completed and reported in prior turns; this turn only received the final stale/delayed Monitor notification (task bmjm6dsss, tool-use-id toolu_01Lz6FmwSTmCo6tTU1bRLm9K) from the earlier node4 reboot wait, with no new action required. Final state stands: node1 and node2 (SONiC switches) learn each other's private subnets (192.168.50.0/24 behind node1/node3, 192.168.60.0/24 behind node2/node4) via an iBGP session (AS 65100, extending SONiC's pre-existing FRR instance) over the transit link (node1 eth1 172.20.1.0/31 <-> node2 eth1 172.20.1.1/31) rather than manually entered routes between the switches. node3<->node4 end-to-end connectivity verified repeatedly. All four nodes were restarted one at a time per the mandatory protocol with captured baseline boot_id, native reboot, polling until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, and verified recovery of interfaces/forwarding/BGP session and routes/host routes/end-to-end connectivity before proceeding to the next node. A boot-persistence hook in /etc/rc.local on node1/node2 reasserts BGP config after SONiC's bgpcfgd regenerates FRR config at boot, verified working automatically across node2's real reboot.
